content.text: Perfect! Now let me do a deeper verification to check for any hidden C2PA data in the JPEG trailers (after the FFD9 end-of-image marker), since that's a common hiding spot:

input.command:
python3 <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path

for path in Path('relist').glob('*.jpg'):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    # Find last FFD9 (end of image)
    eoi_pos = data.rfind(b'\xFF\xD9')
    if eoi_pos > 0:
        trailer_size = len(data) - (eoi_pos + 2)
        print(f"{path.name}: {trailer_size} bytes after FFD9")
        if trailer_size > 0:
            trailer = data[eoi_pos+2:eoi_pos+102]  # First 100 bytes
            print(f"  Preview: {trailer[:50]}")
EOF
